card_text: Low taper fade for Artesia: a gentle fade that stretches the gap between drives down 285.

seo.title: Low Taper Fade for Artesia, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Low and mid taper fades for Artesia, cut in Carlsbad about {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes south on US 285. Grows out gently: for school, for work and for fewer trips.

paragraphs: A low taper trims only the edges: the sideburns, the hair around the ear and the neckline. The sides above keep their length, so the cut looks tidy from the front and never grows a hard line. I cut it in Carlsbad, {{city:artesia.drive_mi}} miles south of Artesia on {{city:artesia.route}}, about {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes each way by OpenStreetMap routing.
Of all the fades on my menu, this is the one that asks the least of that drive.

blocks.heading: A fade that doesn't rush you back.
paragraphs: With so little skin on show, a low taper fuzzes over slowly. The nape is the first spot to lose its edge, and even that is subtle. For someone {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes away, that means a longer stretch between visits than a skin fade would give you. A mid taper, starting up near the temple, shows growth sooner and wants a slightly tighter schedule; I'll tell you which one you're looking at before I start.

items.body: Taper and top, cut to your head shape, with a straight razor cleanup at the neck and a styled finish.

blocks.heading: Cover where you want it.
paragraphs: July highs in Artesia average {{city:artesia.july_high_f}}, and about {{city:artesia.days_100f}} days a year reach 100°F (Open-Meteo, 2023–25). A skin fade is one answer to that. A taper is the other: if you'd rather not have bare scalp out in that sun all summer, it keeps hair on the sides and still cleans up the edges.

It's also the fade I'd point a parent toward. Nearly a third of Artesia is under 18, {{city:artesia.under18_pct}} by Census ACS 2023, more than Carlsbad's {{city:carlsbad.under18_pct}}, and a taper passes a school dress code without a shaved stripe up the side. Same test at a conservative job. Kids book the regular haircut services on Booksy, each in their own slot.

items.q: Low taper or mid taper if I only drive down now and then?
items.a: Low. It keeps more hair on the sides, so the regrowth is softer and the cut stays presentable longer between trips.

items.q: Is a low taper a good first fade for my son?
items.a: It's the gentlest one I do. Nothing goes to skin unless you ask, and it grows out without a step.

items.q: Can I keep my hair long on top with a taper?
items.a: Yes. The taper only touches the edges, so the top can be a crop, a fringe or combed back. The low taper fade page shows a longer top.

items.q: How do I know when it's time to come back?
items.a: When the back of your neck starts looking fuzzy in the mirror. That's the taper's signal.
